sections.heading: One composition, several reusable patterns
sections.text: This placeholder landing page demonstrates template-owned title behavior, responsive feature media, tabs, and native disclosures.

sections.heading: Presentation remains reusable
sections.text: The image, heading, narrative, action, and media position are page configuration. The layout and semantics live in the shared FeatureRow pattern.

items.label: Static first
items.content: The server emits meaningful HTML before interaction JavaScript runs.

items.label: Local state
items.content: Tab selection stays inside the Tabs pattern and does not require global state.

items.label: Keyboard ready
items.content: Arrow, Home, and End keys update the selected tab and associated panel.

items.question: Does the landing page contain custom component code?
items.answer: No. Its route and sections are fully described by validated JSON.

items.question: Is the Undergraduate site being migrated here?
items.answer: No. This neutral reference site proves the framework without importing Undergraduate HTML or production content.
